# gg addon modules

> gg is V's graphics module. A small core owns windows, drawing, cameras,
> math and 3D; larger helpers are opt-in submodules imported explicitly.

## Core

- `import gg`: Context, Config, new_context, run, begin/end, drawing primitives,
  Color, Rect, Vec2, Vec3, Camera2D, Camera3D, Image, text, audio/WAV basics.
- `gg.backend_caps()`: backend name and draw/audio capability flags.
- `gg.Info`: opt-in draw-call and triangle counters.
- `gg/render`: low-level pure-V renderer and CPU rasterizer.
- `gg/m4`: matrix and vector math.
- `gg/canvas`: retained-mode 2D canvas.

## Addons (import only what you use)

- `import gg.anim`: Easing/ease, Tween[T], Timeline, Spring, Noise, curves
  (catmull_rom, sample_catmull, bezier2, resample_polyline), color conversions,
  palettes, AnimClip/AnimPlayer, Quat/quat_slerp, AnimMixer.
- `import gg.game`: Rect/Circle/AABB collision, InputState, Gamepad, FixedStep,
  FrameStats, StateMachine, TileMap, GridPathfinder, geometry (convex_hull,
  polygon_area), procedural (LSystem, voronoi_cells, generate_maze), 3D math
  (Sphere, Plane, Triangle, OBB, Frustum, Octree) and mesh generators.
- `import gg.fx`: ParticleEmitter, CPU post_* filters, audio DSP and SoundVoice,
  UITheme/ui_panel/ui_button/ui_hud, draw_line_chart/draw_bar_chart.
- `import gg.debug`: DebugLog, FrameGraph, Gizmos, SaveStore.
- `import gg.loaders`: load_mesh_obj/gltf/glb, load_model, LoadingManager.
- `import gg.scene`: Node hierarchy, traverse/find, typed Signal[T], App systems.
- `import gg.gpu`: ShaderSource, ShaderMaterial uniform slots, native
  create_shader/destroy (requires an initialized sokol.gfx context).
- `import gg.loaders`: load_gltf_skin and load_gltf_clips for skins and clips.
- `import gg.physics`: sphere rigid bodies, gravity and collision resolution.
- `import gg.splat`: Gaussian splat cloud, projection and CPU rasterizer.
- `import gg.texture`: KTX2 header parsing, format mapping, DXT1 decode.
- `import gg.xr`: stereo camera rig, viewports and convergence point.

## Conventions

- Data and simulation helpers are pure V and work on every backend.
- Drawing and audio-device helpers are native only; the JS compatibility
  backend does not expose gg drawing calls.
- Core gg compiles on wasm. Addons that use slices of structs do not yet.
- Public functions have doc comments starting with the function name.
- Tests are `_test.v` files next to the source; run with `v test <dir>/`.
- Format every file with `v fmt -w` and check with `v fmt -l` before committing.
